how_to_apply: Download the prescribed application form from the official University website.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and experience details.
Pay the applicable application fee via NEFT/RTGS and note the transaction reference number.
Attach self-attested copies of all required certificates, marksheets, proof of date of birth, caste certificate, publications, and experience evidence.

Send the duly filled application form and documents in an envelope superscribed with "Advertisement No. GBU/Admn./TS/2026-09 Dated: 14.10.2026, post applied for the [Post Name] and the Subject/Specialization concerned" by Speed Post, Registered Post, or Courier to: The Registrar, Gautam Buddha University, Greater Noida, Gautam Buddh Nagar-201312 (Uttar Pradesh) India.
Send a scanned copy of the filled application form to [email protected] by email before 13 November 2026 at 05:30 P.M.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The scale of pay for the positions is as per GBU/UGC Regulations, 2018: Professor: Academic Pay Level-14, Rs. 1,44,200/- to Rs. 2,18,200/- Associate Professor: Academic Pay Level-13A, Rs. 1,31,400/- to Rs. 2,17,100/- Assistant Professor: Academic Pay Level-10, Rs. 57,700/- to Rs. 1,82,400/- Appointments are made initially on a contract cum probation basis for a period of one year, which can be extended by a maximum period of one year. Services can be terminated during probation by giving one month notice or one month salary in lieu thereof by either the University or the appointee. Successful candidates must submit a medical examination report from a Government Hospital or Medical Institute and a police verification report.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The application fee must be paid exclusively through NEFT/RTGS to Punjab National Bank, Account No: 6660000100000025, IFSC Code: PUNB0666000, Branch: Gautam Buddha University Campus, Greater Noida, G. B. Nagar (U.P.). The bank payment reference number must be recorded in the application form.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Recent passport-size photograph Copies of marksheets and degree certificates (Master's, M.Phil, Ph.D.) NET/SLET/SET certificates Proof of date of birth Caste certificate / EWS Income and Asset Certificate in prescribed format Evidence of teaching and research experience No Objection Certificate (NOC) from employer (if applicable) Reprints of published articles and research papers Bank payment receipt or reference details for NEFT/RTGS fee payment

faq.question: Q1. Is this job permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: Appointments to the faculty posts are initially made on a contract cum probation basis for a period of one year, which can be extended by a maximum period of one year.

faq.question: Q2. Who is eligible for age and category relaxations?
faq.answer: Relaxations in educational qualifications, experience, and age for reserved category candidates are applicable as per UGC rules and Uttar Pradesh government directives, including valid non-creamy layer OBC certificates and UP-prescribed SC/ST certificates.

faq.question: Q3. How are candidates shortlisted for the interview?
faq.answer: Short-listing of candidates for interview is based on the Academic score specified in Appendix II (Table 3A) of UGC Regulations 2018, and final selections are based solely on interview performance.

faq.question: Q4. What should be written in the subject line or envelope when applying?
faq.answer: Candidates must send the application in an envelope superscribed with the Advertisement Number (GBU/Admn./TS/2026-09 Dated: 14.10.2026), the post applied for (Professor/Associate Professor/Assistant Professor), and the concerned Subject/Specialization.

faq.question: Q5. Which documents must be sent along with the application form?
faq.answer: Applicants must submit self-attested copies of all educational certificates, marksheets, proof of date of birth, caste or EWS certificate, teaching and research experience proofs, published article reprints, NET certificates, and proof of application fee payment.
